_comment: Push notification credentials for the home node. Copy this file to <profileDir>/push-config.json and fill in your values. For dev, you can also set env vars (APNS_KEY_ID, FCM_PROJECT_ID, etc.) — env vars take priority over this file. Profile dir locations: macOS ~/Library/Application Support/EnvoyMesh/profile/, Linux ~/.local/share/EnvoyMesh/profile/, Windows %APPDATA%/EnvoyMesh/profile/, dev ./data/default/.
_comment_paths: File paths (keyPath, serviceAccountJsonPath) support BOTH absolute and relative. Relative paths resolve against the profile dir — so you can drop your .p8 key and service-account JSON next to push-config.json and reference them by filename. Absolute paths work too (e.g. /secure/AuthKey.p8).

apns._comment_topic: topic = the app's bundle ID (Apple calls it 'APNs topic'). Must match the Bundle Identifier in Xcode.
apns._comment_voipTopic: voipTopic = bundle ID + '.voip'. Optional — auto-derived from topic if omitted.
apns._comment_sandbox: sandbox = true for debug/TestFlight builds, false for App Store. Default false.
